rows.ask: Experience contributing to or maintaining a design system at scale.

evidence.line: Built the design system in three layers: foundation tokens, components, and patterns
Built the 13-page design system documenting 125+ components, interaction patterns and accessibility specs

rows.ask: Fluency in Figma and comfort prototyping in code (HTML/CSS/JavaScript or React).

evidence.line: Wired Figma to VS Code via MCP so AI prototypes run on real design-system code
Six live-coded HTML/CSS/JS prototypes exploring plan comparison, cart architecture and pricing display

rows.ask: A track record of partnering with engineering and product to ship, including navigating ambiguity and undefined problem spaces.

evidence.line: Shared prototypes directly with stakeholders and engineering as the specification

rows.ask: Excellent written and verbal communication; you can explain the why behind a decision to executives and to engineers.
Experience with payments, fintech, financial services or other regulated domains.

evidence.line: Prioritized 4 of 10 flows by frequency times pain severity — account setup, login, summary, payments

rows.ask: Experience designing AI-powered features, conversational or agentic experiences, or human-in-the-loop workflows.

evidence.line: Wired Figma to VS Code via MCP so AI prototypes run on real design-system code
Built one board that works face-to-face, against an AI opponent, and online

rows.ask: Experience leading design for a 0→1 product or new business line inside a large organization.
Experience working with international teams and localization; Japanese language ability is a plus for our APAC merchants.

evidence.line: Researched Japanese ennichi festival games and set design criteria (learnable by watching, 1–2 minute rounds, kindergarten to high school)

highlights.role: Lead Product Designer (Agentic UX & AI Systems)
highlights.line: 16+ one-hour interviews with designers and strategists; transcripts clustered with NotebookLM into a searchable pain map
Six live-coded HTML/CSS/JS prototypes exploring plan comparison, cart architecture and pricing display
Designed a 10-foot commerce interface where the TV is the stage and the phone is the input device
Designed a white-label custodial wallet that abstracts away blockchain complexity
Led the discovery audit to find the structural root cause rather than catalog every individual problem
